errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.title: This page could not be loaded

auth.tagline: Short URLs that know where to go.
auth.pointDevices: iPhones to the App Store, Android to Google Play, everyone else to your website.
auth.pointPrivacy: Clicks counted without cookies. IP addresses of clicks are never stored.
auth.pointAgents: Connect an MCP client and let your agent manage links.
auth.name: Name
auth.notAllowed: Sign-up on this instance needs an invitation. Ask an admin of this flitz instance to invite you.
auth.notVerified: Your sign-in provider hasn't verified this email address, so flitz can't let you in with it. Verify the address with the provider, or use your email instead.
auth.failed: Signing in with that account didn't work. Try again, or use your email.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use your email and password, or get a sign-in link by email.
signIn.linkSent: Check your inbox at {{email}} for a sign-in link.
signIn.notVerified: Your email isn't verified yet. flitz sent you a new verification link: check your inbox and open it to sign in.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: Join this flitz instance. If someone invited you, use the address the invitation was sent to.
signUp.checkEmail: Check your email to finish signing up. We sent a link to {{email}}.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.lead: Enter the email you use for flitz to get a link for setting a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If {{email}} belongs to a flitz account, a link to reset the password is on its way. The link works for one hour.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.lead: Choose a new password. Setting it signs you out on every device.
resetPassword.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

shell.changeNameText: Other users of this instance see this name, also in invitations you send.

links.title: Links
links.subtitle: All links on this instance, newest first.

onboarding.title: Create your first link
onboarding.lead: Paste the address people should land on. You get a short URL right away and can add redirect rules for phones or countries later.
onboarding.preview: Your short URL will look like
onboarding.generatedSlugs: This link gets a generated slug. Later links can have a slug of your choice.
onboarding.emptyText: Links you create appear here with their short URL and redirect rules.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: All links on this instance. Days follow the instance time zone, {{timeZone}}.
stats.filterHint: Select a value in a breakdown to filter all stats by it.
stats.chartSummary: Clicks and unique visitors per day from {{from}} to {{to}}. {{clicks}} clicks in total, most on {{day}} with {{peak}}.
stats.chartEmpty: Clicks and unique visitors per day from {{from}} to {{to}}. No clicks in this time range.
stats.uniqueVisitorsHint: Unique visitors are counted per day, so they are not added up for the time range.
stats.noClicks: No clicks in this time range.
stats.qrText: Scans even when partly covered or damaged, which leaves room for the flitz mark in the centre. Use SVG for print, PNG for screens.
stats.orphanText: Requests to a slug that matches no active link, such as a typo in print or a deactivated link that is still in circulation.
stats.noOrphans: No orphan clicks in this time range.

shortUrl.copyLater: Copy short URL, available after you create the link
shortUrl.copyFailed: Your browser blocked copying. The short URL is selected: press Ctrl+C or ⌘C to copy it.

editor.shortUrlText: The address people type or scan.
editor.slugFixed: Domain and slug stay fixed after a link is created, so printed short URLs and QR codes keep working.
editor.slugOptional: Leave the slug empty to get a generated one.
editor.title: Title
editor.defaultTargetText: Where visitors go when no redirect rule matches. You can change it after the short URL is printed.
editor.deactivateText: The short URL stops redirecting. Its slug and clicks stay, and you can reactivate it at any time.
editor.reactivateText: The short URL redirects again, with its current default target and redirect rules.
editor.deleteText: The link and all its clicks are deleted for good, and its slug becomes free. If a new link takes the slug, everyone who still has {{shortUrl}}, in print or as a QR code, lands on the new link's target.
editor.leaveText: You have unsaved changes to this link. If you leave now, they're lost.

rules.title: Redirect rules
rules.text: Rules run top to bottom. The first rule whose conditions all match sends the visitor to its target.
rules.countriesHint: Two-letter country codes, separated by commas
rules.invalidTarget: Rule {{position}}, target: Enter an absolute http or https URL, like https://example.com/page.
rules.invalidCountries: Rule {{position}}, countries: Enter two-letter country codes, like DE.
rules.dragInstructions: To move a redirect rule, press Space or Enter on its handle, move it with the arrow keys, then press Space or Enter again to drop it. Press Escape to cancel.
rules.cancelled: Moving cancelled. Redirect rule {{position}} stays in place.

presets.hint: A preset adds ordinary redirect rules that you can edit, reorder or remove.

appStore.name: App Store
appStore.description: iOS to the App Store, Android to Google Play.
appStore.hint: UTM parameters on the short URL go to Google Play as the install referrer and to the App Store as the campaign token. The App Store provider token is set once in the instance settings. Everyone else goes to the default target.

mobileDesktop.name: Mobile vs desktop
mobileDesktop.description: Phones to a mobile page, computers to the website.
mobileDesktop.hint: Phones and tablets go to the mobile target, computers to the default target.

countrySplit.name: Country split
countrySplit.description: Visitors from chosen countries to their own page.
countrySplit.hint: Use two-letter country codes, like DE, AT, CH. Visitors from these countries go to the target, everyone else to the default target. Apply the preset again for another group.

presets.needsDefaultTarget: Enter the default target first. The preset sends everyone else there.

copy.failed: Your browser blocked copying. Select the text and press Ctrl+C or ⌘C to copy it.

scopes.linksRead: See links, their QR codes and the custom domains.
scopes.linksWrite: Create, edit, deactivate and reactivate links, and generate presets. No API key or app can delete links.
scopes.statsRead: Read click stats and orphan clicks, and export clicks as CSV.
scopes.domainsWrite: Add, update and delete custom domains.
scopes.instanceAdmin: Manage API keys and instance settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Settings for this whole flitz instance. Only admins can change them.
settings.timeZoneText: Days and hours of stats start and end at midnight in this time zone.
settings.retentionText: How long flitz keeps clicks before deleting them for good.
settings.retentionHint: A whole number of months from 1 to 120.
settings.retentionNoteTitle: Older clicks are deleted every night
settings.retentionNote: If you shorten the period, clicks older than the new one are gone after the next nightly run and can't be restored. Links and their short URLs stay.
settings.providerTokenText: Used by the App Store preset. flitz adds it to App Store URLs as pt, so App Store Connect can attribute downloads to your campaigns.
settings.providerTokenHint: Set it once for this instance. The App Store preset adds it to every App Store URL it generates, including through the API and MCP.

domains.title: Domains
domains.lead: Short URLs on your own domain carry your brand. Point the domain at this flitz instance, then add it here.
domains.addText: Use a domain or subdomain you control, like go.example.com. Point it at {{host}} with a CNAME record, so people who open your short URLs reach this instance. For an apex domain such as example.com, which can't have a CNAME record, use an ALIAS or ANAME record, or A/AAAA records with the addresses of {{host}}.
domains.fallbackHint: Where {{hostname}} sends visitors when the slug is unknown or the link is deactivated. Leave it empty to show the not-found page.
domains.generatedSlugs: Slugs here are generated, unless you choose one when you create a link.
domains.deleteText: Only a domain without links can be deleted. An admin can delete its links once they are deactivated.

users.title: Users
users.lead: Everyone who works in this flitz instance. Admins manage users, settings, domains and API keys. Members create, edit and deactivate links. Viewers only see them.
users.inviteText: They join with this role when they sign up with this email address. The invitation works for 48 hours.
users.removeText: {{name}} can no longer sign in to this flitz instance, and their API keys and connected apps stop working. Links they created stay.
users.renameText: Everyone on this instance sees the new name. They can still change it themselves.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.lead: Let software act on this instance through the REST API or MCP. Each API key gets only the scopes you choose.
apiKeys.copyNow: Copy your new API key now
apiKeys.shownOnce: This is the only time flitz shows the API key for {{name}}. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
apiKeys.createText: Name it after what will use it, so you know what stops working when you revoke it.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeText: Software that uses this API key can no longer act on this instance. You can't undo this.

mcp.title: Connect via MCP
mcp.lead: Let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor work in flitz: create links and set up redirect rules. Every API operation is an MCP tool, limited by the scopes you grant.
mcp.connectText: Works with any app that supports remote MCP servers with sign-in.

add.title: Add the URL as a custom connector
add.text: Look for custom connectors or MCP servers in your AI app's settings and paste the URL.

signIn.title: Sign in to flitz
signIn.text: A browser window opens. Use the account you use here.

choose.title: Choose the scopes
choose.text: The app can only do what those scopes allow. Agents can deactivate links but never delete them.

claude.name: Claude
claude.text: In Claude, open Settings › Connectors, add a custom connector and paste the MCP server URL. Then choose Connect and sign in to flitz.

chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.text: In ChatGPT, turn on developer mode under Settings › Apps & Connectors › Advanced settings. Then create a connector with the MCP server URL and OAuth authentication, and sign in to flitz.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.text: Add flitz to ~/.cursor/mcp.json, or to .cursor/mcp.json in a project. Cursor asks you to sign in to flitz the first time it connects.

mcp.headlessText: No browser to sign in with? Send an API key in the Authorization header instead. The API key's scopes apply.
mcp.connectedAll: AI apps that users connected to this instance. Disconnecting one stops its access right away.
mcp.connectedOwn: AI apps you connected to this instance. Disconnecting one stops its access right away.
mcp.disconnectText: {{name}} loses access to this instance right away. To use it again, connect it again.
mcp.keyHint: Replace flitz_... with your API key. The API key's scopes apply.
